# Sheet
Atlas Sheet v1 — an edge-anchored panel, same anatomy as Drawer (header with inline close, description, content, footer), extended to 4 sides. When to use: bottom is the mobile bottom-sheet pattern (has the drag handle); top/start/end cover the same edge-anchored idea from the other 3 edges. When not to use: a centered, momentary decision (use Dialog) or a persistent side menu (use Drawer — same start/end geometry, but no handle, and Drawer is the side-panel-specific name). Do: keep the flush edge (against the viewport) flat and the free edge(s) rounded; only Side=bottom gets the drag handle. Don't: add a handle to top/start/end.
